content: Disparities in obesity and diabetes management are significantly influenced by socioeconomic, structural, and social factors. These disparities can lead to unequal health outcomes among different populations. Healthcare providers are strongly encouraged to evaluate various determinants that may affect a patient’s ability to manage their health. These include assessing the safety of the patient’s neighborhood, their access to nutritious and affordable foods, and their cultural background. By understanding these factors, providers can deliver personalized and effective care to individuals and groups who are at higher risk of poor health outcomes.
